method: End-to-end UI verification in connected browser at verified mobile CSS viewport sizes
currentImplementation: Deterministic retrieval from 9 demonstration knowledge articles, not an external AI model
checks: Mobile menu opens AI Jana; dialog, composer and reply content fit narrow screens
Enter sends exactly one message and clears the draft
Shift+Enter inserts a newline without sending; multiline question returns supported answer
600-character message sends and wraps without horizontal overflow
601-character input is blocked with the visible message to shorten the question
Textarea uses 16px font and remains accessible with a 360x460 available viewport
Supported vacation and Academy questions return article text with the correct source link
Sources open in the mobile reading panel; return-to-chat preserves conversation
Source action opens the linked Jana Academy section and closes chat
Closing and reopening chat preserves turns for the current page session
New dialog clears turns and draft and restores suggested questions
Broad question 'Отпуск' asks for clarification without citations
Unknown HR payment rules receive refusal without invented amounts
Request to approve vacation receives refusal to perform actions
After off-topic questions, a supported question still returns its correct source
Refusals do not inherit sources from prior answers
Reload clears conversation as disclosed in the interface
